# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z). date-modified / doi /
# keywords / description / categories are not rendered in the title
# block yet; P3 (bd-j6huijli) adds them and strengthens these
# assertions (p.date-modified, p.doi > a, div.keywords,
# div.quarto-categories > div.quarto-category, …).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default",
            "div.quarto-title > h1.title",
          ]
